title: cleistanthus oblongifolius
intro: Cleistanthus oblongifolius, commonly known as Indian Tinospora or Tinospora cordifolia's relative, is a plant species native to tropical regions. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cleistanthus oblongifolius include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may help in reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and treating skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Cleistanthus oblongifolius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids.
